**v1.9.2: when the vision helper stops as the bot starts, debug.log now says why - and a bug report carries the helper's own log.**
- **What was wrong.** You saw "vision off" on the Dashboard, and the map and the overlay said "the vision helper isn't running". debug.log said only "Vision: the helper didn't answer - cards are found with ImageSearch (see vision\vision.log)", two seconds after the bot started: the helper (vision\vision.py, run by pythonw, which has no window) had stopped as it started, and nothing said why. A Python without numpy or Pillow stopped before the helper's log was made, so vision.log got nothing; an error while it started wasn't written anywhere; and a bug report didn't carry vision.log, the helper's own log. Without that the cause isn't known yet: this version makes the bot say it.
- **What you'll see now in debug.log**, at the bot's start, when the helper doesn't come up - one of:
  - "Vision: the helper stopped at start - vision\vision.log: <its line> - cards are found with ImageSearch", its line being the helper's own reason: "can't start: numpy and Pillow didn't load in Python 3.x.y at <the pythonw.exe it ran on> (<the error>) - Setup.exe's "numpy and Pillow" installs them"; "can't start: <the error> - in <where it came from>" for any other error while it started; or "port 47128 taken (...) - another copy is running". The Python named is the one the bot found and ran the helper on: numpy and Pillow have to be in that one.
  - "Vision: the helper stopped at start without a line in vision\vision.log - the Python at <its path> couldn't run it at all (Setup.exe's "Python 3" and "numpy and Pillow" parts set it up again) - cards are found with ImageSearch".
  - "Vision: the helper is still starting after 8 s - vision\vision.log: <its last line> - it's stopped, cards are found with ImageSearch" (it ran but didn't answer).
- **The old helper.** At its start the bot stops a helper left running from before, as ever, and now waits till that one no longer answers - up to 5 s - before starting its own. Before, it waited 0.3 s, and a new helper started while the old one still held the port (it answers for about half a second after it's told to stop) could clash with it over the port. debug.log says so only when it took long: "Vision: the old helper took N s to stop", or "Vision: the old helper still answers 5 s after it was told to stop - starting the new one anyway".
- **Bug reports** (Report a bug, with its log box ticked) now carry the last 40 lines of vision\vision.log too, under their own heading after debug.log's, with what looks secret blanked out the same way.
- **Nothing else changes:** how cards are found, the helper's answers and the simulator are as in v1.9.1.
- **If vision is still off,** send a bug report (it carries both logs), or the "Vision:" lines from debug.log's start and AutoFarmer\vision\vision.log.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** The bot's side was only read, not run (no AutoHotkey or Windows where it was made). The helper's side is tested: a Python without numpy or Pillow, an error at start and a taken port each write their line in vision.log.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
